note: Provider destination ids, kept out of the canonical geography on purpose (roadmap §51). Yalidine and Zedair renumber their destinations on their own schedule; holding their ids here means that churn never touches the wilaya and commune tables, and adding a third provider is a data change rather than a schema change. Populated from each provider's own docs during roadmap §53 — do not fill this in from memory.

fields.commune: optional — the commune name; omit it to map the whole wilaya, which is how stopdesk services are addressed
fields.destination_id: required — the provider's own identifier, stored as an opaque string and never parsed as a number
fields.metadata: optional — an object of provider-specific extras
